summary: Publish a typed faux catalog from PGDataLayer and render it on a new /catalog page in GoReactChat web, pinned to the data commit from the same change.
approach: PGDataLayer: add JSON Schemas for category and product, 5 categories and 25 products as JSON.
PGDataLayer: add a validator (ajv) run by npm test that checks schema conformance and categoryId references.
PGDataLayer: generate index.d.ts from the schemas (json-schema-to-typescript) and add npm run check that fails when it is stale.
GoReactChat web: depend on pgdatalayer at the data PR's head SHA; add src/app/catalog/page.tsx grouping products by category.
GoReactChat web: add vitest with a component test rendering the page from the package data.

changes.purpose: devDependencies, check script, exports for types
pgdatalayer dependency at SHA, vitest, test script

tests.name: test/data.test.mjs: every data file validates against its schema
npm run check: generated types are current
web-ci: lint, typecheck, test, build against pinned pgdatalayer SHA

risks: Next.js 16 conventions differ from older versions; follow web/AGENTS.md and bundled docs.
